sources.title: oddadmix/Nawah-VL-50M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The language model is oddadmix/50M-2048-Emhotob, trained from scratch on Arabic. The vision tower is SigLIP2 as distributed in LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M, used unmodified and frozen; those weights remain LiquidAI's and their licence terms apply to that component.
